programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal
programme.desc: When Natwar's elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brother's humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Demon
programme.desc: Vignesh Shivan has scary dreams that bother him a lot. However, the strange things in his dreams make him worry and affect his mind.

programme.title: Powerfull Yoddha
programme.desc: Chandu is very passionate about kickboxing and his life revolves around his mother and his girlfriend. His life is shattered when his dying mother asks him to meet his estranged father Raghuveer.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Saheli
programme.desc: Kunti abandons her baby in order to lead a lavish life and marries a rich man. Years later, she realises that her husband is indulging in an affair and is shocked to find out the truth about the girl.

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: The Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: Overworked estate agent Jim Evers takes his beleaguered family to look round an isolated, crumbling mansion - but the resident ghosts are not especially pleased to see the visitors. Comedy based on the Disney theme-park ride, starring Eddie Murphy, Terence Stamp, Jennifer Tilly and Marsha Thomason.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp

Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: A rat finds his love of fine food has made him an outcast to his less discerning family. Separated from his fellow rodents by a storm, he winds up in a famous French restaurant, where he helps an incompetent kitchen assistant become the greatest chef in Paris. Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: A lonely, orphaned computer genius forms a special bond with an inflatable robot. When a devastating event occurs in their futuristic home city, they join forces with a group of friends to form a hi-tech band of heroes who are determined to get to the bottom of the matter. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: Hitman: Agent 47
programme.desc: The latest in a long line of genetically engineered clones bred to be the perfect assassin takes on a mission that strikes close to home. A corporation intends to use the technology that created him to build an army of superhuman killers. As the assassin fights to bring them down, he uncovers the dark secrets surrounding his origin. Action thriller, starring Rupert Friend, Hannah Ware and Zachary Quinto.

programme.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
programme.desc: A teenager uses a graduation speech to publicly reveal a few secrets - including proclaiming his love for a pretty classmate. To his surprise, she is flattered by the gesture, but her ex-boyfriend is furious and they are soon forced to spend a night fleeing for their lives together. Comedy, starring Paul Rust and Hayden Panettiere.

programme.title: Hitchcock
programme.desc: Following his success with North by Northwest, director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel Psycho. After being refused backing by the studio Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. Even with His wifes support, Alma Reville, the production strains the couples marriage. Fact-based drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren and Scarlett Johansson.

Remake of 1961 Disney comedy The Absent-Minded Professor, with Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Christopher McDonald and Wil Wheaton.

programme.desc: Chefs compete for the chance to cook at a glittering Olympic banquet. The North West finalists go head-to-head as they prepare a lavish meal for judges Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: In the battle of the London and South East chefs newcomers Phil Howard, Graham Garrett and Marcus McGuinness present their starter menus. Will it be Phil with spring salad with goat's milk puree, pickled asparagus and quail's eggs; Graham with pickled rabbit, wild garlic quinoa and frozen rabbit liver parfait; or Marcus with iced lamb's liver parfait, malt loaf, fingerling limes and rose geranium?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Newcomers Phil Howard, Graham Garrett and Marcus McGuinness present their fish courses. Will it be Phil with a tasting of Cornish mackerel with oysters, mussels, winkles and samphire; Marcus with pollock, peas, coconut and elderflower; or Graham with octopus, blood orange, feta cheese, squid ink tuile and black olive salt?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Phil Howard, Graham Garrett and Marcus McGuinness cook their main courses, but only one chef will take gold. Will it be Phil with roast loin of lamb with pie and mash, carrots, nettles and mint; Graham with slow cooked marsh lamb breast, rasher and spiced rissole; or Marcus with blade of beef cooked in hay, tendons and beetroot?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Phil Howard, Graham Garrett and Marcus McGuinness present their dessert dishes here. Will it be Phil with rhubarb and custard souffle, Marcus with asparagus, goat's curd and black olive, or Graham with lemon meringue? Veteran Jason Atherton decides who goes through to the judges and who is going home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is decision time for the chefs from the London and South East region. The two remaining chefs cook their entire menus for judges Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. The judges aren't easily pleased and only world class cooking will do. The chef's task is to create a menu which captures the Olympic spirit.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the battle of the Wales chefs: returning contenders Richard Davies, James Sommerin and Stephen Terry. All are determined to knock out their rivals in the race to the banquet. Stephen Terry cooks `The Opening Ceremony', Richard Davies makes ravioli of quail, parfait of foie gras, roasted salsify and Madeira jelly, and James Sommerin cooks sage cream, onion, chicken and Welsh `Brie' truffle toast.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Richard Davies, James Sommerin and Stephen Terry are all determined to knock out their rivals in the race to the banquet. They cook their fish course, but which one will prevail? Will it be Stephen Terry with `The Fish and Shellfish Medley', Richard Davies with compression of vine tomato, poached lobster and hand dived scallop, or James Sommerin with lobster and Iberico ham, spiced butter and broccoli?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Richard Davies, James Sommerin and Stephen Terry cook their main course, but only one chef will take gold. Will it be Stephen Terry with `The Bunny Pentathlon', Richard Davies with slow cooked rib of beef, beetroot ketchup, bone marrow and braised shallot, or James Sommerin with mangalitsa pork, carrot, liquorice and leek?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Richard Davies, James Sommerin and Stephen Terry cook their dessert, but who will impress? Stephen Terry with `Bronze, Silver or Gold?', Richard Davies with passion fruit cream and gel with bitter chocolate sorbet or James Sommerin with raspberry and lemon cheesecake? `Great British Menu' veteran Angela Hartnett decides who goes through to the judges on Friday and who is going home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is decision time for the chefs from Wales. The two remaining chefs cook their entire menus for judges Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. The judges aren't easily pleased and only world class cooking will do.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: South West contenders Paul Ainsworth and Nathan Outlaw, plus newcomer Simon Hulstone, kick things off with their starters, but which one is going to be first off the blocks? Will it be Paul with his `Breakfast of Champions'; Nathan with hogs pudding with seaweed, potato terrine and mushroom ketchup; or Simon Hulstone with track and field - beetroot and goats cheese?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their fish course, but which one but which one will prevail? Will it be Paul Ainsworth with monkfish `Two Showings'; Nathan Outlaw with mackerel, horseradish and oyster sauce; or Simon Hulstone with `The Swimming Pool'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their main course, but which chef will take gold? Will it be Paul Ainsworth with `Wishful Chicken'; Nathan Outlaw with duck, barbecue monkfish, rosemary, samphire and asparagus; or Simon Hulstone with lamb with salted toffee pea mousse, shallot puree and asparagus?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the chefs' final chance to impress the veteran with their dessert dishes. Will it be Paul Ainsworth with `Then and Now'; Nathan Outlaw with elderflower and lemon tart, with strawberry sorbet and meringues; or Simon Hulstone with `Closing Ceremony'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time on Great British Menu for the chefs from the South West region. One chef left the competition on the previous day and only two remain to cook their entire menus for the `Great British Menu' judges, Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. The judges aren't easily pleased and only world class cooking will do.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The 2012 competition enters its final week. The winners of the regional heats compete for a chance for their dish to be on the final banquet menu at a prestigious event hosted by Sir Steve Redgrave with a glittering guest list of British Olympians. Here, the finalists cook their starters, which will be tasted and scored by the `Great British Menu' judges and veteran judge Richard Corrigan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The eight winners of the regional heats prepare to cook their fish dishes, which will be tasted and scored by the `Great British Menu' judges and veteran judge Marcus Wareing. Before they get into the kitchen, they must first learn whether they will all be cooking.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: On day three, the chosen finalists cook their main courses, which will be tasted and scored by the `Great British Menu' judges and veteran judge Tom Kerridge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's desserts day in the finals, and the last chance for the competing chefs to impress the judges and veteran Angela Hartnett. After a hard-fought week, the end of this programme will see the judges finally reveal the winning four dishes which will make up this year's `Great British Menu'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This final programme follows the successful chefs in the run-up to the Olympic banquet at the Old Royal Naval College in Greenwich, as they make the painstaking preparations for what is one of the most important meals they will ever cook. The four winning chefs prepare an outstanding four-course menu for a truly Olympian guest list.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The spotlight is on Scotland. Returning contenders Michael Smith, Tony Singh and Mark Greenaway are all determined to get one of their dishes to the banquet. Will a witty take on spiced ham score highly, or will a warm chicken salad with a twist or a rabbit terrine come out on top? Veteran judge Angela Hartnett MBE will be judging.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Returning contenders Michael Smith, Tony Singh and Mark Greenaway cook their fish dishes. Will a traditional Scottish soup, a chowder or a risky no-cook mackerel dish impress veteran judge Angela Hartnett MBE?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The competition heats up as the three returning Scottish contenders, Michael Smith, Tony Singh and Mark Greenaway, cook their main courses. An African inspired goat tagine, a beef dish inspired by a childhood cartoon and a duck dish with a comedy twist are dished up for veteran judge Angela Hartnett MBE.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Scottish returning contenders Michael Smith, Tony Singh and Mark Greenaway have just one more chance to impress veteran judge Angela Hartnett MBE and win their place in front of the judges. Will a comedy custard pie, a sophisticated chocolate dessert or doughnuts inspired by a Scottish tradition come out on top?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Only one chef can make it through to the national finals to represent Scotland and cook at a special banquet at the Royal Albert Hall.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The curtain raises on the competition in the North West. How will Aiden Byrne's dish entitled `Mad as a Box of Frogs' go down with veteran Phil Howard? Will he trounce Mary-Ellen McTague's crab starter or will Chris Holland's `Oriental style beef broth with a twis' score more highly with Phil?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The North West chefs cook their fish courses. Will Aiden Byrne's `The Culinary Joke' - a take on a classic prawn cocktail - raise a laugh, or will Mary-Ellen McTague's dish of dover sole or Chris Holland's `Gone Fishing' salmon dish prove winners?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their main course. Will Aiden Byrne's witty beef dish entitled `Long Horn Beef with Noodle Pot' prove a winner, or will Mary-Ellen McTague's goat dish called `Our Kid' raise a smile? Perhaps Chris Holland will score highly with his dish called `A Tasting of Pork'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the chef's last chance to impress before the final two are chosen to face the `Great British Menu' judging panel. Which dessert will help get them through? Will it be Aiden Byrne's pineapple dish called `The Sweet Burger', Mary-Ellen McTague's take on a trifle called `Chamomile Lawn' or Chris Holland's dish called `Going Bananas'?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time for the chefs from the North West. One chef has already left the competition and only two remain. The judges are joined by celebrity guest judge writer, presenter and performer Rowland Rivron.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: In central England, three culinary heavyweights return to the `Great British Menu' kitchen. Two Michelin star chef Daniel Clifford creates a dish called `A Trip to the Chippy', where nothing is as it first appears. That is also the theme for Michelin star chef Richard Bainbridge's starter, `banana split', while Will Holland offers up goats cheese mousse, balsamic jelly and gingerbread.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Here, the chefs try to impress with their fish courses. Daniel Clifford puts up a creative dish called `Catch of the Day'. Does Richard Bainbridge's dish titled `Tongue in Cheek' live up to its comedy name? Will judge Marcus Wareing find the comedy value in Will Holland's coconut poached brill, crab, celeriac and tomato essence?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Here, the chefs try to impress with their fish courses. Daniel Clifford puts up a creative dish called `Catch of the Day'. Does Richard Bainbridge's dish titled `Tongue in Cheek' live up to its comedy name? Will judge Marcus Wareing find the comedy value in Will Holland's coconut poached brill, crab, celeriac and tomato essence?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs in central England cook their main courses. Daniel Clifford's main has the same title as Richard Bainbridge's fish course, `Tongue in Cheek', but it is a wildly different plate of food; Richard Bainbridge presents guinea fowl in a beef bladder and calls the dish `Which Came First: the Chicken or the Egg'; Will Holland offers roast longhorn beef rib eye, bread and bone marrow pudding and parsley paste.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs in central England have one last chance to impress Marcus Wareing before the final two are chosen to face the judging panel. Will Daniel Clifford's `Going Out with a Bang' be good enough? Has Richard Bainbridge dropped the comedy ball with his coffee and chocolate dessert called `Time to Reflect'? Or will an unusual dish of parsnip banoffee cake, chocolate tart and parsnip ice cream get Will Holland through?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time for the chefs from the central England region. Only two chefs remain to cook their entire menus for judges Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. The panel is joined by guest judge, comedian and actor Jim Moir, known to millions as Vic Reeves.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The South West chefs battle it out for a chance to cook at the special banquet. Will veteran judge Tom Kerridge like Chris Eden's modern twist on `Duck a l'Orange', or will he favour Peter Sanchez-Iglesias' dish called `Picnic'? Perhaps Emily Watkins's witty dish called `Eggs and Ham' will prove a winner.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The South West chefs cook their fish courses here. Cornishman Chris Eden takes inspiration from home to create a lobster and oyster dish called `Gone Surfing', Peter Sanchez-Iglesias cooks up a dish inspired by childhood memories titled `Fish and Chips', while Emily Watkins serves up a dish with cured trout called `High Tea'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The South West chefs cook their main courses and veteran Tom Kerridge is looking for perfection. Will Chris Eden's spin on a fast food classic simply called `B.L.T' gain top points? Or will Peter Sanchez Iglesias' nostalgic dish `Roast Dinner' or Emily Watkins' venison dish `Shoot Lunch' prove a winner?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: For the South West chefs, which dessert will progress? Peach melba, apple pie and `Lolly and Sweets' fight it out.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's decision time for the chefs from the South West and only two remain. Who will cook their entire menus for the `Great British Menu' judges, Prue Leith, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton and their guest, writer and performer Simon Day? The judges aren't easily pleased and only world-class cooking will do.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Welsh chefs raise the curtain with their starters, but which one is going to produce a showstopper? Will veteran Jeremy Lee be impressed with Richard Davies's chicken salad or will Mary Ann Gilchrist's peas and ham or Luke Thomas's ham, egg and pineapple get them off to a flying start?

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E25 — Colombia v DR CongoColombia v DR Congo (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' second match in Group K, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Colombians have reached the knockout stage on three of the six occasions they have qualified for the finals, including their most recent appearance in 2018. Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.desc: S7 E3 — Gold CoastThe Walshes are halfway through their Australian road trip, and have reached the Gold Coast. programme.desc: S2 E8Adil Ray hosts as Faye Tozer and Lee Latchford-Evans of Steps take on comedian Russell Kane and Big Brother's Will Best to win money for their chosen charities. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

The Colombians have reached the knockout stage on three of the six occasions they have qualified for the finals, including their most recent appearance in 2018. Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E25 — Colombia v DR CongoColombia v DR Congo (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' second match in Group K, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Colombians have reached the knockout stage on three of the six occasions they have qualified for the finals, including their most recent appearance in 2018. Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as Tom from Liverpool, Jessica from Lincoln, Felix from Ilfracombe and Linda from Lowestoft pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught

programme.title: Bradley & Barney Walsh: Breaking Dad
programme.desc: The Walshes are halfway through their Australian road trip, and have reached the Gold Coast. Barney has sun, sea and some serious action planned - starting with a trip to the beach, where they join a local outrigger canoe club for a race on the water. Next, the pair visit a wildlife hospital that was set up by the animal-loving Steve Irwin and his family. The duo also learn the art of synchronised swimming and meet a stunt man who has worked alongside some of Hollywood's biggest stars

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: Adil Ray hosts as Faye Tozer and Lee Latchford-Evans of Steps take on comedian Russell Kane and Big Brother's Will Best to win money for their chosen charities. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Türkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E25 — Colombia v DR CongoColombia v DR Congo (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents all the action from both teams' second match in Group K, held at Guadalajara Stadium in Mexico. The Colombians have reached the knockout stage on three of the six occasions they have qualified for the finals, including their most recent appearance in 2018. Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

Having faced Uzbekistan in their opening group contest, they will be looking to secure a place in the last 32 here before a final-game showdown with Portugal. However, they can take nothing for granted against the talented African outfit who are looking to make an impact in their first finals since 1974, when the country was known as Zaire. Colombia made a good start to their campaign on Wednesday with a 3-1 victory against Uzbekistan, while DR Congo played out an impressive 1-1 draw against Portugal. With analysis from Karen Carney and Jobi McAnuff, and commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Andros Townsend.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E28 — Türkiye v USATürkiye v USA (Kick-off 3.00am). Laura Woods presents coverage of the Group D match at Los Angeles Stadium in Inglewood, USA. The USA have already won the group and will play in the last 32 on Wednesday in Santa Clara, while Türkiye have already been eliminated following defeats to Australia and Paraguay. Four of the five previous meetings between these nations have taken place since the turn of the century, and all of them have ended in a 2-1 scoreline. Two were in favour of the Americans, and the other two went the way of the Turkish, including the most recent encounter in June last year, when Arda Güler and Kerem Aktürko?lu were on the scoresheet in East Hartford, Connecticut. While the Crescent-Stars haven't appeared at a World Cup since 2002, the Americans had two group-stage matches against European opposition four years ago, beginning their campaign with a 1-1 draw against Wales that saw Gareth Bale equalise late on from the penalty spot after Timothy Weah had given USMNT the lead in the first half, before they moved on to play England in their second game, which ended in a drab 0-0 draw. With analysis from Juan Mata, Ange Postecoglu and Bradley Wright-Phillips, and commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon.

programme.title: When Fred Met Rose
programme.desc: Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

programme.title: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
programme.desc: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they `got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

programme.title: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
programme.desc: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.

programme.title: Myra Hindley: The Untold Story
programme.desc: Exploring Hindley's childhood and the start of her relationship with Brady.

programme.title: Myra Hindley: The Untold Story
programme.desc: The stories of the victims and those who got away.

programme.title: Myra Hindley: The Untold Story
programme.desc: A look at the life and crimes of infamous killer Myra Hindley. This film explores the stories of Brady and Hindley's five known murder victims and the accounts of the children who got away, most notably David Smith.

programme.title: Conviction: Murder at the Station
programme.desc: Following a team of experts as they investigate whether evidence exists that could challenge the conviction of a man in prison for a murder he denies. Every year, over 500 people in the UK are convicted of murder. A guilty verdict can only be challenged if new evidence comes to light. Inside Justice is a specialist charity led by Louise Shorter, supported by a panel of criminal lawyers, ex-police officers and forensics experts who offer assistance to prisoners who are protesting their innocence.

programme.title: Conviction: Murder at the Station
programme.desc: Louise investigates a case, looking for evidence that could present grounds to bring an appeal, and ultimately overturn the conviction of a Southampton man in prison for the murder of his secret lover.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Dennis Nilsen
programme.desc: Dennis Andrew Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophiliac who murdered at least 12 young men and boys in London between 1978 and 1983.

programme.title: Britain's Forgotten Serial Killer
programme.desc: This is the chilling but little-known story of Trevor Hardy, the serial killer known as the `Beast of Manchester' who murdered three teenage girls between December 1974 and March 1976.

programme.title: Killed Walking Home
programme.desc: Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. These women could be sisters, daughters and friends. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case, what comes in light of the investigation is one that leaves an everlasting scar on the families.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Rose West
programme.desc: Rosemary Pauline West is an English serial killer who collaborated with her husband, Fred West, in the torture and murder of at least nine young women between 1973 and 1987. She also murdered her eight-year-old stepdaughter, Charmaine, in 1971. Delve into the psychology of Rose to try and understand what turned her into such a cruel rapist and murderer.

programme.desc: Expert Chris Shaw meets Farah who brings in her family's Qur'an. Having been made in Kashmir in around 1910, its 600 pages were handwritten from memory but the book is starting to show its age with torn pages and misshaped binding. Harry and Belinda visit metal worker Dominic Chinea with their dented two-wheel scooter that was gifted to Belinda 61-years-ago. Art Conservator Lucia Scalisi is delighted to unwrap a topographical painting of Marsala brought in by Gaspare who inherited the artwork from his grandfather Vito who passed away in 2020. Cracked, painted over and way past its prime, Lucia works hard to uncover and restore the hidden gem. Finally, Richard and his daughter Nicky bring in a diamond ring containing the ashes of her late mother, Julie. programme.title: The Abyss: Rise And Fall Of The Nazis
